squareSelection: Use square tops across each same-layer cardinal-connected ground cohort touching ground one layer above within a 3x3 neighborhood. Hover previews query the cohort without changing emitted neighbors.
bottomWallConstruction: Recess a backing core derived from the original fractured walls below Z=0.78. Embed unequal closed faceted boulders into the core or other rooted masses, forming broad slanted shoulders, deep creases and overlapping side clusters. Preserve the original top band, both UV charts, caps and shared PBR maps.
bottomFloorConstruction: An irregular triangulated floor closes the recessed core; staggered embedded boulder masses form the visible rocky underside.
bottomOverhangPolicy: Only geometry below Z=0.78 may overhang, by at most 0.04 tile units on exposed cardinal sides. Hidden connection planes retain the unit footprint and their lower border at Z=-0.34. The preserved upper band retains its original shape.
bottomBorderCompression: Apply a small affine XY compression only to the accepted BoulderMassNN and FloatingRockNN shapes, reducing the exposed-side envelope from 0.12 to 0.04 while preserving facets, topology, UVs and Z coordinates. The core, hidden connection planes and upper band remain unchanged.
bottomExportPolicy: Normal export preserves native mesh edits; -- --remodel-bottom-variants explicitly rebuilds all bottom variants from the regular source bodies using tools/sculpt_ground_bottoms.py, applies the final border compression and updates linked preview meshes. The separate -- --tighten-bottom-borders option compresses existing boulder and floating-rock groups without rebuilding their shapes. Original regular/square GLBs, cap tables and PBR maps remain unchanged.
bottomSelection: Use the bottom body when no full-cell ground, wall, cliff wall, decorative block or live ice block exists directly below in the full level/editor document or current movable state. Hidden layers still provide support; water, air, thin plates and moving platforms do not. Logical cell bounds and authored caps are unchanged.
